Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills. Factory code is department-agnostic.

OWNED FILES (only these; both new):
  factory/selfheal.py
  tests/test_selfheal.py

CONTEXT — the LOCKED self-heal contract (read wayfinder/drafts/13-auto-patch-proposal.md in full): a five-rung automated repair ladder runs to exhaustion BEFORE any human — L0 retry, L1 deterministic known-fix playbook, L2 self-patch, L3 cross-model repair, L4 contain-and-degrade, L5 human with a decision-ready dossier. Tripwires: budget 10 auto-patches/department/week (breach jumps to L4+L5); 3 cumulative failed L2+L3 attempts on one node demotes it to propose-only, AUTO-reset after 7 clean days. HARD FLOOR: in this build, L2/L3 are PROPOSE-ONLY — the class is not promoted, so nothing auto-applies; the machinery produces change-card artifacts and dossiers, never edits code. Existing related machinery to read (do not modify): factory/heal_ladder.py (escalation state machine), departments/podcast/runtime/heal_select.py / heal_apply.py / heal_verify.py (playbook-driven L1 lane), departments/podcast/runtime/playbooks.json.

BUILD factory/selfheal.py — the ladder STATE MACHINE + artifact generator, pure and deterministic (caller supplies time, like heal_ladder.py):
1. LadderState persistence: load_state(state_dir) / save_state(state_dir, state) as atomic JSON at <state_dir>/selfheal_state.json holding per-node: {rung_attempts: {L0..L3: int}, failed_patch_attempts: int, demoted_until: iso|null, weekly_budget: {week_start: iso, auto_patches_applied: int}}.
2. next_rung(state, node, incident, *, now) -> {'rung': 'L0'|'L1'|'L2'|'L3'|'L4'|'L5', 'reason': str} implementing: L0 for first sight of a transient-class incident; L1 when a playbook id matches (incident carries 'playbook_candidate'); L2 then L3 for auto-fixable fix-classes (incident 'fix_class' in an AUTO_FIXABLE set {'runtime_config','stale_artifact','dependency_pin','node_code'}); NEVER L2/L3 when fix_class in ALWAYS_HUMAN {'meaning','grading','leak_adjacent','governance'} — those go straight to L5 with reason naming the class; L4 when rungs exhausted or weekly budget breached; L5 after L4. Demoted nodes (demoted_until > now) skip L2/L3 with a visible reason. record_patch_outcome(state, node, ok, *, now) increments/demotes (3 cumulative failures) and auto-resets demotion after 7 clean days.
3. Change-card generator: propose_patch(state_dir, incident, rung, *, now) -> Path writes a versioned PROPOSE-ONLY card to <state_dir>/heal_proposals/<UTCdate>-<node>-<n>.json: {schema:'heal-proposal/v1', rung, node, incident_fingerprint, fix_class, diagnosis, proposed_action, requires: 'full QA + re-shadow + re-pin', auto_apply: false, created_at}. Never writes outside heal_proposals/.
4. Dossier generator: build_dossier(state_dir, node, incidents, attempts, *, now) -> dict — the L5 packet: every attempt with rung/reason/outcome, current state, ONE recommended_action string; write_dossier() appends it to <state_dir>/heal_dossiers.jsonl (append-only, fsync).
5. All functions raise ValueError naming bad fields; no wall-clock anywhere — 'now' is always a parameter.

tests/test_selfheal.py — at least 12 tests: rung progression L0→L1→L2→L3→L4→L5 across repeated incidents; ALWAYS_HUMAN fix_class goes straight to L5 with the class named in reason; 3 cumulative patch failures demote (L2/L3 skipped with visible reason); demotion auto-resets after 7 clean days (time injected); weekly budget at 10 jumps to L4 and resets on a new week; proposal card is auto_apply false and lands only under heal_proposals/; dossier lists every attempt and exactly one recommended_action; state roundtrips atomically; corrupt state file raises with the path named; deterministic given fixed 'now'.

VERIFY: 'python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 12 new 'def test_' functions, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: the locked L0-L5 ladder exists as a deterministic state machine producing propose-only change cards and decision-ready dossiers, with budget, demotion, and auto-reset tripwires

CONTEXT: factory/evalregistry.py (read it) implements the locked evaluator contract: load_registry, resolve, classify_defects (block/revise/allow from severity-weighted defects), gating (advisory until a golden set passes). departments/social/runtime/eval_registry.yaml declares node_class draft_qa with verdict thresholds and golden_set null (= advisory). qa_post.py currently emits {pass, defects, engine, model, usage, ...} with binary pass and no severities.

CHANGES to qa_post.py (preserve everything else — flags, engine calls, receipts, shadow semantics):
1. Give every deterministic defect a severity: extend the existing defect dicts with 'severity' — read each check in deterministic_defects and assign honestly: sanitization/provenance/leak-adjacent failures are 'critical'; content-contract violations (schema, banned phrases, CTA cardinality, ungrounded claims) are 'major'; style-level items are 'minor'. Model-judgment defects from _model_defects get 'major' unless the model output names a severity.
2. Load the department eval registry (path: same directory eval_registry.yaml; tolerate absence → behave exactly as today, binary pass only, and note 'registry: absent' in the report). When present: resolve node_class 'draft_qa', run classify_defects over the collected defects → add to the report: 'verdict' (block/revise/allow), 'gating' (from evalregistry.gating with golden_set_passed False for a null golden set → 'advisory'), and keep the existing boolean 'pass' EXACTLY as today (pass stays the gating truth while Tier-2 is advisory — state this in a comment).
3. The evaluator field written into the run record/receipt gains {verdict, gating} alongside the existing content.

tests/test_qa_verdict.py — at least 6 fixture tests (reuse the monkeypatch pattern from tests/test_engine_usage_parse.py): a critical defect yields verdict block; three majors block; one major yields revise; clean draft yields allow; gating is 'advisory' with the real social registry file; registry absence degrades gracefully to today's binary behavior with 'registry: absent' noted; existing 'pass' boolean unchanged in every case.
